name: Fabric Factory Lab
product_goal: Teach visual Data Factory/Fabric pipeline orchestration and Mapping Data Flow concepts locally, with selected activities executing for real against DuckDB/DuckLake.

major_surfaces: Mapping Data Flow Studio: row/data transformations
target_state.graph_rule: Reuse the renderer and shared mechanics, but keep pipeline, Mapping Data Flow and Airflow domain models separate.
real_local_execution_targets: SqlScript: real DuckDB SQL, never mislabeled as SQL Server T-SQL
mapping_data_flow_targets: real Data Preview from partial-flow execution
simulated_or_external_only: SQL Server stored procedures unless a real SQL Server adapter is connected
Microsoft Fabric cloud activities unless an explicit external adapter is connected
Spark partition behavior when no real Spark runtime is selected

scope_boundary.not_airflow: FactoryLab teaches visual Data Factory orchestration, not Python-first Airflow scheduling.
scope_boundary.not_contoso: FactoryLab consumes/moves/transforms data; Contoso owns the broader analytics/data-platform model.
scope_boundary.not_datapass: FactoryLab is not a LeetCode/coding drill product.

next_assembly_step: Create/assign a standalone frontend repo, extract the Fabric donor UI, connect it to fastapi-fabric, then make Copy/Lookup/SQL real before expanding breadth.
